company.name: Komodo Health
company.shortDescription: Komodo Health is an IT firm that specializes in data engineering, life sciences, artificial intelligence, and machine intelligence services.
company.description: Komodo Health develops computer software that brings transparency and market intelligence to healthcare and life sciences. Its software platform applies artificial intelligence and other advanced data science techniques to its Healthcare Map. The company empowers a multitude of healthcare stakeholders life science companies, healthcare payers and providers, patient advocacy groups, and others to create a more cost-effective, value-driven healthcare system.
